coordinates: Metres east and north of the extent's south-west corner — the same frame as the map geometry, so a search result is already a map position.

source.publisher: City of Melbourne Open Data Portal

note: This index is the pilot boundary. An address in it is covered; an address on one of these streets but not in it is a real place the pilot does not reach; anything else is outside what this product can speak about. It carries only what a search and a pin need, and travels to the browser so that no address typed into the search box is ever sent anywhere.
